request.style: English, male solo voice, warm and clear, acoustic guitar, cello, soft piano, gentle drums, reflective and solemn, 75 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
This is the family history of Esau
That is, Edom in the hill country of Seir
He took wives from the daughters of Canaan
And moved away from his brother Jacob

[Chorus]
Chief Pinon stands in the list of names
A chief among the clans and regions
One of the leaders descended from Esau
Part of the structure of the people

[Verse]
Chief Timna and Chief Alvah are named
Chief Jetheth holds his place in the land
Chief Oholibamah and Chief Elah
Chief Pinon completes the line

[Chorus]
Chief Pinon stands in the list of names
A chief among the clans and regions
One of the leaders descended from Esau
Part of the structure of the people

[Bridge]
The possessions were too great to live together
The land could not support their livestock
So they settled in the hill country of Seir
Where the Edomites took their place

[Chorus]
Chief Pinon stands in the list of names
A chief among the clans and regions
One of the leaders descended from Esau
Part of the structure of the people

[Outro]
Name by name in the genealogy
Chief Pinon of the land of Edom
